title: Structurally diverse flavonoids from the seeds of Astragalus complanatus with ferroptosis regulation via the NOX4/Nrf2 axis in neural cells.
authors: Zhao, Kang-Hong; Fang, Xu-Tong; Zhu, Yue-Tong; Zhang, Yue-Jin; Gao, Yu-Qi; Shi, Qiang-Qiang; Gao, Jin-Ming
one_liner_zh: 该研究从扁茎黄芪种子中分离黄酮类化合物并验证其通过NOX4/Nrf2轴调控神经细胞铁死亡，虽含分子动力学模拟但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA体系完全无关。
abstract: The seeds of Astragalus complanatus R. Br. (SAC), a medicinal food homologous resource, are widely distributed and utilized in China. A phytochemical investigation of the seeds of SAC afforded 47 flavonoids, including eight previously undescribed ones, designated as complanatin A (2), and neocomplanatosides A-G (38, 39, and 43-47). Among them, 43 and 44 are phenylpropanoid-esterified flavonoid glycosides, while 45-47 represent a rare class of sesquiterpene-esterified flavonoid glycosides. Their structures were elucidated by the NMR and HRESIMS spectroscopic data, and ECD calculations. Biological evaluation demonstrated that rhamnocitrin (15) inhibited ferroptosis in erastin-induced HT22 cells (EC(50) = 7.79 +/- 0.44 muM) by suppressing NOX4 expression and activating the SLC7A11/Nrf2 pathway. Molecular dynamics simulations confirmed its stable binding to NOX4 (RMSD <0.4 nm; DeltaG(bind) = - 47.92 kJ/mol), and competitive inhibition with GLX351322 further confirmed NOX4 as the direct target. These findings indicate that flavonoids from SAC, particularly rhamnocitrin (15), are promising natural neuroprotective candidates for food-based health applications.
abstract_zh: 扁茎黄芪（Astragalus complanatus R. Br.）的种子（SAC）是一种药食同源资源，在中国广泛分布和利用。对SAC种子的植物化学研究获得了47种黄酮类化合物，其中包括8种先前未描述的化合物，命名为complanatin A (2)和neocomplanatosides A-G (38、39和43-47)。其中，43和44为苯丙素酯化黄酮苷，而45-47代表了一类罕见的倍半萜酯化黄酮苷。它们的结构通过NMR和HRESIMS光谱数据以及ECD计算得以阐明。生物学评价表明，鼠李柠檬素（rhamnocitrin, 15）通过抑制NOX4表达并激活SLC7A11/Nrf2通路，抑制了erastin诱导的HT22细胞中的铁死亡（EC(50) = 7.79 +/- 0.44 μM）。分子动力学模拟确认了其与NOX4的稳定结合（RMSD <0.4 nm；DeltaG(bind) = -47.92 kJ/mol），与GLX351322的竞争性抑制进一步证实NOX4为直接靶点。这些发现表明，SAC中的黄酮类化合物，特别是鼠李柠檬素（15），是食品基健康应用中具有前景的天然神经保护候选物。
